summary.en: The Kenya Intellectual Property Bill 2026 establishes a unified Authority to manage and protect patents, copyrights, and anti-counterfeit measures in Kenya.
summary.sw: Mswada wa Miliki Ubunifu wa Kenya wa 2026 unaanzisha Mamlaka ya pamoja ya kusimamia na kulinda hataza, hakimiliki, na hatua za kupambana na bidhaa ghushi nchini Kenya.

en: This Bill seeks to merge and streamline the administration of intellectual property rights in Kenya.
It establishes the Kenya Intellectual Property Authority to handle patents, utility models, industrial designs, copyrights, and anti-counterfeit enforcement.
The Bill introduces modern rules for emerging technologies, including the exclusion of artificial intelligence-generated inventions from patent protection.
It also sets up an Intellectual Property Tribunal to resolve disputes efficiently.
Furthermore, it provides clear guidelines on the disclosure of biological resources and traditional knowledge in patent applications.
sw: Mswada huu unalenga kuunganisha na kurahisisha usimamizi wa haki za miliki ubunifu nchini Kenya.
Unaunda Mamlaka ya Miliki Ubunifu ya Kenya ili kushughulikia hataza, mifano ya matumizi, michoro ya viwanda, hakimiliki, na udhibiti wa bidhaa ghushi.
Mswada huu unaanzisha sheria za kisasa kwa teknolojia zinazoibuka, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutenga uvumbuzi unaozalishwa na akili mnemba (AI) kutoka kwenye ulinzi wa hataza.
Pia unaanzisha Baraza la Miliki Ubunifu ili kutatua migogoro kwa ufanisi.
Zaidi ya hayo, unatoa miongozo ya wazi kuhusu ufichuzi wa rasilimali za kibiolojia na maarifa ya asili katika maombi ya hataza.

text.en: Establishes the Kenya Intellectual Property Authority as a corporate body with the power to sue, be sued, and manage property.
text.sw: Inaanzisha Mamlaka ya Miliki Ubunifu ya Kenya kama shirika la kisheria lenye uwezo wa kushtaki, kushtakiwa, na kusimamia mali.

text.en: Outlines the Authority's duties, including registering patents, licensing collective management organizations, and combating counterfeit goods.
text.sw: Inaainisha majukumu ya Mamlaka, ikiwa ni pamoja na kusajili hataza, kutoa leseni kwa mashirika ya usimamizi wa pamoja, na kupambana na bidhaa ghushi.

heading.en: Meaning of Invention and AI Exclusions
heading.sw: Maana ya Uvumbuzi na Kutengwa kwa Akili Mnemba

text.en: Defines what constitutes an invention and explicitly excludes artificial intelligence-generated inventions and algorithms from patent protection.
text.sw: Inafafanua nini maana ya uvumbuzi na inatenga wazi uvumbuzi na algoriti zinazozalishwa na akili mnemba (AI) kutoka kwenye ulinzi ya hataza.

text.en: Requires patent applicants to show proof of prior informed consent if their invention uses biological resources or traditional knowledge.
text.sw: Inataka waombaji wa hataza kuonyesha uthibitisho wa idhini ya mapema ikiwa uvumbuzi wao unatumia rasilimali za kibiolojia au maarifa ya asili.

text.en: Provides that inventions made during employment belong to the employer, but guarantees the employee fair payment for exceptionally important creations.
text.sw: Inaeleza kuwa uvumbuzi unaofanywa wakati wa kazi ni mali ya mwajiri, lakini inahakikisha mwajiriwa anapata malipo ya haki kwa uvumbuzi wa umuhimu wa kipekee.

text.en: Sets the lifespan of a patent at twenty years from the date the application was filed.
text.sw: Inaweka muda wa kudumu wa hataza kuwa miaka ishirini tangu tarehe ya kuwasilishwa kwa ombi.

text.en: Allows copyright owners to send notices to online service providers to remove content that infringes on their intellectual property.
text.sw: Inaruhusu wamiliki wa hakimiliki kutuma ilani kwa watoa huduma za mtandaoni ili kuondoa maudhui yanayokiuka haki zao za miliki ubunifu.

text.en: Creates the Intellectual Property Tribunal to hear appeals and resolve disputes related to patents, copyrights, and trademarks.
text.sw: Inaunda Baraza la Miliki Ubunifu ili kusikiliza rufaa na kutatua migogoro inayohusiana na hataza, hakimiliki, na alama za biashara.
